name: 2MA_4Level
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system across four progressively larger position levels to enter trend-following trades. It opens additional positions at each crossover confirmation level, scaling into trends with increasing lot sizes. Exits are triggered on MA crossover reversal or take-profit/stop-loss levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉系统，通过四个递进仓位级别进行趋势跟踪交易。每个交叉确认级别开立额外头寸，在趋势中逐步加仓。出场依靠均线交叉反转或止盈止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是双均线交叉趋势跟踪，通过快速均线与慢速均线的交叉判断趋势方向。入场条件为快均线上穿慢均线时做多，下穿时做空，并分四个级别逐步加仓，每个级别的仓位大小递增，属于金字塔加仓模式。出场条件依赖均线反向交叉信号，或触及预设的止盈止损水平。仓位管理采用四级递进加仓，可能在趋势延续时积累较大头寸。资金管理方面，缺乏明确的单笔风险控制比例，加仓级别可能导致总仓位过重。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在震荡行情中容易频繁开平仓造成损失，且四级加仓在没有严格止损的情况下风险较大。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a dual moving average crossover trend-following system, using the crossover of a fast and slow moving average to determine trend direction. Entry conditions are a bullish crossover (fast MA crossing above slow MA) for long positions and a bearish crossover for short positions, with positions scaled in across four progressive levels, each with increasing lot sizes in a pyramiding fashion. Exit conditions rely on a reverse MA crossover signal or hitting preset take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing employs a four-level progressive scaling approach, which can accumulate large positions during extended trends. Money management lacks a clear per-trade risk percentage control, and the escalating level sizes may result in excessively heavy total exposure. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, but it is prone to frequent whipsaw trades in ranging markets, and the four-level pyramiding without stringent stop-loss discipline poses significant risk.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit per order in pips

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和调试
四级加仓模式能在强趋势中充分获利，利润空间大
设有明确的止盈止损，具备基本风险控制框架
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Four-level scaling-in allows capturing maximum profit during strong trends
Has explicit take-profit and stop-loss, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 双均线交叉在震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续亏损
四级递进加仓没有最大仓位限制，在不利行情中可能导致严重亏损
缺乏震荡/趋势市场状态过滤器，无法自动适应不同市场环境
cons_en: Dual MA crossover generates frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Four-level progressive scaling has no maximum position cap, potentially causing severe drawdowns in adverse conditions
Lacks a range/trend market state filter, cannot automatically adapt to different market environments
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX），仅在趋势明确时开仓，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
加入最大总仓位限制和整体风险敞口控制，防止单一方向累积仓位过大
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to only enter trades when the trend is clear, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Implement a maximum total position limit and overall risk exposure control to prevent excessive accumulation in one direction

risk_points: 四级加仓模式在趋势反转时可能造成较大回撤
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在一根K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Four-level scaling-in can cause significant drawdowns on trend reversals
Lacks new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions within a single bar
